title: Smelter and mineral processing facilities, source-attributed facility inventory
methodology: Track a unique facility/project entity rather than conflating a park's tenants with an industrial park owner. Enriched entries overlay the existing named ESDM registry by original_id; other ESDM entries are retained with unknown capacity/ownership and explicit 2026 status not verified. WGS84 pins are locality references only; facility-site surveyed coordinates have not been established. Nameplate/design capacity, actual annual production, ore throughput, and announced future capacities are different denominators and must never be summed. 2025 ESDM 28 integrated smelters (13 operating / 15 development) is a narrow regulated cohort, NOT a 2026 nationwide census of all nickel-park tenants, alumina or industrial facilities.

official_baseline.scope: ESDM Ditjen Minerba 2025 integrated/regulated smelter tracking cohort; not full national all-industry census
